qr.alt: QR code linking to the phone controller for this board

error.title: Board unavailable
error.body: This board could not be loaded. Check the address on the screen.

rescan.title: Scan the board again
rescan.body: This link has expired. Point your phone at the code on the board to take control again.

status.trimmed: Sent — trimmed to fit the board
status.failed: That didn't reach the board. Try again.
status.rescan: Your access expired. Scan the code on the board again.

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: Hold the button and say what the board should say.
voice.trimmed: On the board — trimmed to fit
voice.repaired: On the board — tidied up to fit the grid

error.denied: No microphone access. Allow it in your browser settings — or just type your message above.
error.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Type your message above instead.
error.too_short: That was too short. Hold the button down while you speak.
error.mic: The microphone wouldn't start. Check nothing else is using it.
error.transcribe: That didn't come through. Hold the button and try again.
error.generate: The board didn't take it. Try again.
error.insecure: Voice needs a secure connection. Open this page over https (or on the same device as the server) — or just type your message above.

paint.hint: Pick a colour, then tap a tile, drag across a run of them, or tap a row number to fill that row. A tile painted into empty space snaps to the left edge.

history.title: Recently on the board
history.empty: Nothing has been on this board yet.
history.replay: Put revision {{revision}} back on the board
